text:
jess-support: Tenant-B escalated — p99 for /v1/generate jumped ~4x right after canary rollout (~2024-11-10T17:45Z). Customer reports 700ms -> ~2800ms. They attached HAR and screenshot. Can someone triage?

sam-sre: looking. Do we have the exact canary ID?

jess-support: canary: rollout-2024-11-10-c2; tenant id: tenant-b. Support attached trace id abc123def.

maria-platform: our internal p99 panel (rollup) shows a small blip around that time but not 4x. Customer screenshot shows big spike. Likely aggregation mismatch between customer-collected and our rollup.

sam-sre: running quick query against raw histograms now:

```
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="/v1/generate", tenant="tenant-b"}[5m])) by (le))
```

sam-sre: query shows p99 ~2.6s at 17:47UTC matching them. So dashboard rollup is underreporting.

maria-platform: ah — we rolled out "smart-rebin" in rollup service on 2024-11-10 17:30 to reduce cardinality. It can smooth the tail for small-traffic tenants. That would hide spikes.

anya-ops: customer says spike correlates with auth failures then retries. Trace abc123def shows repeated 401->retry->200 and retry_count=2 with added backoff. snippet:

```
span: auth-proxy.request
status: OK
retry_count: 2
auth_status: transient-401
latency_ms: 2100
trace_id: abc123def
```

mike-eng: are retries coming from our auth proxy or from customer SDK?

sam-sre: trace shows upstream=auth-proxy-5. The auth proxy started a new image in canary too. Could be a regression.

maria-platform: two issues then: (1) rollup smoothing hides the spike on our dashboard, (2) auth-proxy retry amplifies per-request latency for tenant-b.

jess-support: customer is asking for mitigation now. Options?

mike-eng: short-term: add per-tenant fallback routing to previous auth-proxy pool for tenant-b, or disable smart-rebin for tenant-b dashboards.

anya-ops: also can reduce retry_count at proxy to avoid adding ~1.5s per retry while we investigate.

sam-sre: I'll open an incident and revert rollup smart-rebin for the affected window and spin up previous auth-proxy for tenant-b.

opsbot: Incident INC-4567 created by sam-sre — priority P1.

maria-platform: I'll add an annotation on dashboards and mark the rollup config change at 17:30 UTC. Also will add query for raw histogram panel for all tenants as a fallback.

jess-support: I'll update tenant-b with repro steps and ETA. Repro steps (customer-safe):

```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate?tenant=tenant-b" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"test"}' -v
```

jess-support: Thanks all :thumbsup: will post progress here.

mike-eng: looping @security to inspect whether auth-regression exposes anything.

sam-sre: action items: revert smart-rebin (maria), spin up auth-proxy-legacy for tenant-b (mike), update customer (jess).

jess-support: ETA for customer update ~30m.

anya-ops: noted.

maria-platform: rolling back smart-rebin for tenant-b dashboard now.

sam-sre: legacy proxy up, routing tenant-b to legacy pool. Early numbers show p99 dropped back to ~650ms.

jess-support: customer confirmed latency back to normal. Closing loop once postmortem written.

opsbot: Incident INC-4567 status: mitigated
